missing: Deiva et al. 2021, Hum Gene Ther 32:1251, doi 10.1089/hum.2021.135 (PMID 34405688), the 5.5-year follow-up of rAAV2/5-hNAGLU. In 3 of 4 patients brain atrophy and neurocognition 'did not differ from untreated Sanfilippo A/B children'. This is a 2021 efficacy entry on mps3b-dog-aav5-intracerebral (contra if secondaries are admitted). It also adds an engagement datum (CSF NAGLU 18%) and a safety datum (no acquired tolerance).

No dose entry for the mps3b-dog-icv-ta track. Ellinwood 2022 (PMC9426762) states the 48 mg dog dose 'provides a sufficient safety margin over the clinical dose (300 mg weekly)'. Dogs tolerated it and patients were dosed at 300 mg, so this is a candidate same with margin_stated.

Regulator reliance is pending. Spruce Biosciences reports positive Type B and pre-BLA meetings with FDA (investors.sprucebio.com news releases; BLA planned Q4 2026) on CSF HS-NRE as the endpoint, which rests partly on the dog CSF/brain HS-NRE correlation. There is no label yet, so regulatory_reliance stays false for now.
SBC-103 (IV protein) nonclinical toxicology has no dose or safety track; the data are presumably unpublished. An untested/unpublished opening entry would show that the model existed.
ABO-101 (AAV9-NAGLU, Abeona, NCT03315182) and its Naglu-/- mouse data are outside the given member list, so they are not scored. I am flagging this only so the class table can be checked.
rule_questions: Every class member's phase 1/2 trial has safety as its only registered primary, except TA, where DQ is co-primary. Is efficacy then untested, or may the efficacy secondary be scored without a pre-specified poc_gate?

Is a track the animal colony (the MPS IIIB dog, the Naglu-/- mouse) whatever the product and route (intraparenchymal AAV vs ICV enzyme; IV vs ICV enzyme), or the animal crossed with the delivery route? The answer decides the merges and therefore engagement 6.
An NHP or dog study was run before the trial (IND-enabling) but published after it. Does its stated tolerability margin count as 'stated before the trial' for margin_stated?
Member 'lesinidase alfa' is assumed to be SBC-103 (Alexion/Synageva rhNAGLU). I did not confirm the INN mapping.

Models check: efficacy 7-8 on naglu-ko-mouse-aav-intracerebral rest on rule question 1 (secondary efficacy). If admitted, does Deiva 2021's age-dependent outcome (youngest patient benefited; mice treated at 6 weeks) make the 2021 entry contra or untested (condition not tested)?

Models check: dose 6 (mps3b-dog-icv-ta) proposed retro because Ellinwood 2022 states the 300 mg margin while citing Muschol 2021 patient CSF HS normalization; if the dog dosing ran pre-trial, does a margin first stated after patient results count as margin_stated (rule question 3) or only as retro?
